ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Crime, Film, and Neoliberalism in Latin America: An Introduction." All seats reserved for Spanish major seniors during the early registration period. Non-registered students are not allowed to sit in or audit. Meets with PORT 406. (Taught in Spanish. To register, students who wish to take this course for credit in Portuguese should contact the department. Enrollment in PORT 406 will not count toward fulfillment of the graduation requirements for the undergraduate major in Spanish.) Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes.
